title: Magical Explorer Anime Casts M.A.O as Nanami
content: The official website for the television anime of Iris and Noboru Kannatsuki 's Magical Explorer light novel series revealed on Friday that M.A.O will play Nanami. M.A.O previously voiced the character in a promotional video for the original light novel series.
author: ANN

title: BLACK TORCH Opening Video Featuring Theme Song "FREEZE ME UP" by SiM Released
content: BLACK TORCH revealed the opening video featuring the theme song ahead of the anime’s July 4, 2026 premiere. As previously confirmed , the series will stream on Crunchyroll. The series first announced the anime adaptation back in March, surprising with its return following the manga’s cancellation in 2018.
author: Anime Corner

title: Sekiro: No Defeat Anime Reveals Theatrical Trailer
content: The staff for Sekiro: No Defeat , the new anime based on FromSoftware 's Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice game, began streaming a theatrical trailer on Friday. The staff also revealed a few more staff members, including: • Liquid Art: Atsushi Harada • Color Grading: Tatsuya Fukumoto • Sound Effects: Kiyotaka Kawata •…
author: ANN

title: Sekiro: No Defeat New Trailer Revealed for Theatrical Release
content: SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT anime revealed a new trailer for its theatrical release, which is scheduled to premiere on September 4, 2026 in Japan with a limited three-week run. The anime is coming exclusively to Crunchyroll in 2026. The reveal was first made today during the Annecy International Animation Film Festival 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'You, Fireworks, and Our Promise' Anime Film Reveals Clip Featuring Protagonist Makoto Natsume
content: The staff for the anime film of Kaori Mado 's You, Fireworks, and Our Promise ( Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to or Kimi-Hana for short) novel series began streaming a new clip on Friday from the film featuring protagonist Makoto Natsume.
author: ANN

title: Victoria of Many Faces Anime's New Short Promo Video Highlights 8 Characters
content: The staff for the television anime of writer Syuu and illustrator Nanna Fujimi 's Victoria of Many Faces ( Tefuda ga Ōme no Victoria ) light novel series revealed a new short "Delightful People" promotional video on Friday.
author: ANN

title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Reveals 2nd STAGE Key Visual, New Details Set for July 3
content: Warner Bros Japan revealed a key visual for STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure 2ND STAGE , while confirming that new information about the anime will be revealed during Anime Expo 2026 on July 3.
author: Anime Corner

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Game's Trailer Previews Boss Battle
content: CAPCOM unveiled a new "game overview" trailer for its Onimusha: Way of the Sword game on Thursday. The video shows gameplay footage of combat with the boss Dohatsu-ten. The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam, and Switch on September 25.
author: ANN

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3 Game Reveals 'Side Stories' DLC Trailer
content: CAPCOM unveiled a new trailer on Thursday for the "Side Stories" DLC for Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection , a new turn-based role-playing game in its Monster Hunter franchise . The trailer previews the upcoming side stories and their focus characters.
author: ANN

title: Aoashi Season 2 Anime Reveals New Visual, Theme Song Artists
content: The staff of the television anime of Yūgo Kobayashi 's Aoashi manga revealed a new visual and the theme song artists for the anime's second season on Friday. 10-FEET will perform the opening theme song for the first half of the second season (first 12 episodes), while Ai Higuchi will perform the ending theme song.
author: ANN
